Why the richest man said success rubs off on you.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of Aristotle Onassis, the shipping tycoon. Onassis said that if he lost all his money, he would go where rich and successful people gather. Asking questions helps, he said, but simply being in their presence changes you.

Kevin adds that who you spend time with is who you become. That is why he says a mentor or coach matters so much.

Who is in your circle right now, and where is it taking you?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Most people wait to be wealthy before they give. Rockefeller did not.

Kevin Trudeau says what you sow, you reap. He points to John D. Rockefeller, one of the richest men who ever lived. Rockefeller began giving a tenth of his income from his very first job, when he earned almost nothing. He said it was that giving that made him wealthy.

Kevin says very wealthy people give a large share of their income away because they understand giving and receiving.

When did you last give without expecting anything back?
